items.name: agent-ui-core
items.title: agent-ui core
items.description: Shared hooks (clock, announcer, scoped shortcuts), status dot and the token stylesheet every component uses.

items.name: agent-trail
items.title: Agent Trail
items.description: The steps an agent works through as one trail: live timer on the running step, sub-steps, approval waits, retry on failure, folded history, screen-reader announcements.

items.name: agent-plan
items.title: Agent Plan
items.description: Review an agent's plan before it runs: rename in place, reorder by drag or Alt+Arrow keys, add and remove, then run with live status and retry from a failed step.

items.name: approval-gates
items.title: Approval Gates
items.description: A stack of approval requests with risk, diff and arguments; approve, reject with a reason or edit JSON arguments first; undo window; second confirmation for high risk; scoped A/R/E shortcuts.

items.name: agent-inbox
items.title: Agent Inbox
items.description: All background agent tasks in one list: filter tabs with counts, search, needs-you first, roving-tabindex keyboard navigation, rows that unfold to recent steps and actions.

items.name: away-summary
items.title: Away Summary
items.description: While-you-were-away card: how long you were gone, what needs you, what failed and what is done, one action per row; folds to a divider that keeps the counts.

items.name: ai-answer
items.title: AI Answer
items.description: Streamed answer from a string or async iterable, citation chips with previews on hover and keyboard focus, unresolved citations flagged, source cards, copy with sources, feedback with a note, follow-ups.
